column1: # Xenoblade Chronicles 3 (Monolith Soft), SDK 12.3.9, NVN. Started as the provisional profile from the survey (dm/games/profile_guess.py) and checked by hand
# while bringing it up on Android (Lenovo Legion Y700, 2026-10-25).
# the NPDM declares 32 MB of system resource (virtual address memory) and main never sets a heap. nninitStartup reserves a 60 GB address region (mov x0, #0xf00000000
# at main+0x128e58c, the allocator at main+0x124081c) and commits it in 1 MB steps until a map fails: a 64 GB alias region holds the reservation, and the host refuses
# maps past the application pool as Horizon does (mem_map_limit), which ends the probing; with the guessed 4.375 GB region nninitStartup crashed in a memset of null
# the NPDM declares 32 MB of system resource
# the shaders are Monolith HCPS archives (SLCT programs) inside xbc1 streams in bf3.ard, a few standalone SLCTs in main, and Firehawk's GLSLC effects; the DLC
# (aoc/1-4, Future Redeemed in 4) carries archives of its own (shader_split.py mono_shaders / slct_loose, DM_SPLIT_AOC)
